section_1_identification.recommended_use: Industrial solvent for coatings, printing inks, and chemical syntheses
section_1_identification.address: 123 Industrial Estate Road, Map Ta Phut, Rayong 21150 Thailand

hazard_statements: H225: Highly flammable liquid and vapour
H304: May be fatal if swallowed and enters airways
H336: May cause drowsiness or dizziness
H361d: Suspected of damaging the unborn child
H373: May cause damage to organs through prolonged or repeated exposure
precautionary_statements: P210: Keep away from heat, hot surfaces, sparks, open flames and other ignition sources. No smoking.
P280: Wear protective gloves/protective clothing/eye protection/face protection.
P301+P310: IF SWALLOWED: Immediately call a POISON CENTER/doctor.

section_4_first_aid.inhalation: Remove victim to fresh air and keep at rest in a position comfortable for breathing. If breathing is difficult, administer oxygen. Seek immediate medical attention.
section_4_first_aid.skin_contact: Wash with plenty of soap and water. Take off contaminated clothing and wash before reuse. If skin irritation occurs: Get medical advice/attention.
section_4_first_aid.eye_contact: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. If eye irritation persists: Get medical advice/attention.
section_4_first_aid.ingestion: Do NOT induce vomiting. Risk of aspiration into lungs. If conscious, rinse mouth with water. Seek emergency medical attention immediately.
section_4_first_aid.acute_delayed_symptoms: Headache, dizziness, fatigue, nausea, central nervous system depression.
section_4_first_aid.physician_notes: Treat symptomatically. Watch for potential chemical pneumonitis if aspirated.

section_5_fire_fighting.suitable_extinguishing_media: Dry chemical powder, alcohol-resistant foam, carbon dioxide (CO2), water spray or fog.
section_5_fire_fighting.unsuitable_extinguishing_media: Do not use solid water stream as it may scatter and spread fire.
section_5_fire_fighting.specific_hazards: Vapours are heavier than air and may travel along the ground to distant ignition sources and flash back. Toxic fumes containing carbon oxides may be released during combustion.
section_5_fire_fighting.protective_equipment_for_firefighters: Wear full protective bunker gear and self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) operating in positive pressure mode.

section_6_accidental_release.personal_precautions: Eliminate all ignition sources. Evacuate non-essential personnel. Wear complete chemical-resistant PPE including organic vapor respirator.
section_6_accidental_release.protective_equipment: Nitrile/butyl rubber gloves, splash goggles, antistatic boots, organic vapor mask.
section_6_accidental_release.environmental_precautions: Prevent entry into waterways, sewers, basements, or confined areas.
section_6_accidental_release.cleanup_methods: Absorb spill with non-combustible absorbent material (vermiculite, dry sand, earth) and transfer into closed, grounded containers for disposal.

section_7_handling_storage.handling_precautions: Use only in well-ventilated areas or under local exhaust. Ground/bond container and receiving equipment. Use non-sparking tools. Avoid contact with skin and eyes.
section_7_handling_storage.storage_conditions: Store in a cool, dry, well-ventilated place away from direct sunlight, heat, sparks, and open flame. Keep container tightly closed.
section_7_handling_storage.incompatibilities: Strong oxidizing agents, strong acids, halogens.
section_7_handling_storage.packaging_materials: Steel drums, glass containers, fluorinated HDPE.

section_8_exposure_controls.engineering_controls: Explosion-proof local exhaust ventilation system. Eye wash stations and safety showers must be readily accessible within 10 seconds.
section_8_exposure_controls.ppe_respiratory: NIOSH-approved half-mask or full-face respirator with organic vapor cartridges (A1/A2 filter).
section_8_exposure_controls.ppe_hands: Viton or Nitrile rubber chemical-resistant gloves (>0.4 mm thickness, breakthrough time >480 min).
section_8_exposure_controls.ppe_eyes: Chemical splash goggles or full face shield conforming to EN 166 or ANSI Z87.1.
section_8_exposure_controls.ppe_body: Flame-retardant antistatic protective clothing, chemical apron, and antistatic safety shoes.

section_9_physical_chemical.solubility: 0.52 g/L in water @ 20 °C (Immiscible); miscible with ethanol, ether, acetone, chloroform

section_10_stability_reactivity.reactivity: Stable under recommended storage and handling conditions.
section_10_stability_reactivity.chemical_stability: Chemically stable under normal ambient conditions.
section_10_stability_reactivity.hazardous_reactions: Vapors may form explosive mixture with air. Violent reaction with strong oxidizers.
section_10_stability_reactivity.conditions_to_avoid: Heat, sparks, open flames, hot surfaces, direct sunlight, static discharge.
section_10_stability_reactivity.incompatible_materials: Strong oxidizing agents (nitric acid, sulfuric acid, peroxides), halogens.
section_10_stability_reactivity.hazardous_decomposition_products: Carbon monoxide (CO), Carbon dioxide (CO2), dense toxic smoke during thermal decomposition.

section_11_toxicological.skin_corrosion_irritation: Causes moderate skin irritation with prolonged contact.
section_11_toxicological.serious_eye_damage_irritation: Causes slight to moderate eye irritation.
section_11_toxicological.carcinogenicity: IARC Group 3: Not classifiable as to its carcinogenicity to humans. ACGIH A4: Not classifiable as human carcinogen.
section_11_toxicological.mutagenicity: Negative in bacterial reverse mutation tests (Ames test).
section_11_toxicological.reproductive_toxicity: Suspected of damaging the unborn child (Developmental toxicity demonstrated in animal studies).

section_13_disposal.waste_treatment_methods: Incinerate in a licensed hazardous waste incineration facility with flue gas scrubbing in compliance with Department of Industrial Works regulations.
section_13_disposal.packaging_disposal: Dispose of empty containers as hazardous waste. Do not puncture, cut or weld empty drums.

section_15_regulatory.safety_health_environmental_regulations: Ministerial Regulation on Hazardous Chemicals B.E. 2556, DLPW Notification on TLV B.E. 2560 (Item 289)
section_15_regulatory.thai_hazardous_substance_act_category: Type 3 Hazardous Substance under the control of Department of Industrial Works (DIW)

section_16_other.references: Royal Thai Gazette, ACGIH TLVs 2026, NIOSH Pocket Guide to Chemical Hazards, ECHA Dossier
